verdict.rationale: Bruno's marketing page claims it can "Serve realistic mock responses while you build," indicating some mock-server capability, but there is no further documentation on generating mocks from saved examples or an OpenAPI spec, no mention of exposing the mock server to external consumers, and no independent corroboration. missing for 10: documentation on generating mocks from examples/spec, details on hosting/sharing the mock server for consumers, independent verification of this feature.
